name: com.certapoland/assessment
title: Certa Poland - employment in Poland
description: Certa Poland: prices, guides, Polish employer cost estimates, assessment and consultation requests.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List packages and pricing for hiring and payroll in Poland (single source of truth for price). `serviceRoutes` lists the three routes (direct employment, Polish company setup, running a Polish entity) with price type fixed/from/range/quoted_after_assessment; `amount: null` means quoted after assessment, never zero.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the published guides on hiring, payroll, social security and permanent-establishment risk in Poland. Returns Markdown excerpts with a citable URL for each guide.

tools.name: estimate_employment_cost
tools.description: Estimate the full employer cost ("gross-to-gross") of one employment contract in Poland from a monthly gross salary in PLN. Indicative model for a foreign employer with no Polish establishment: returns the January breakdown, the low/high band driven by the statutory accident-insurance rate, and the assumptions behind every number. `estimate.totalMonthly` is one person's January employment cost WITHOUT Certa's fee and WITHOUT setup. The additive `budget` block adds, for an optional headcount, the Certa fee (EUR 300 per employee per month, from get_services) and the model-year total (sum of 12 modelled months); there is no separate setup fee - registrations and HR documentation are included in the monthly fee (`budget.complete: true`). Not legal or tax advice.

grossSalary.description: Monthly gross salary in PLN. Always PLN, regardless of the currency field.

ppk.description: Whether the employee participates in PPK (auto-enrolment pension plan).

accidentRate.description: Employer accident-insurance rate as a fraction (statutory range 0.0067–0.0333). Omit for the default rate.

currency.description: Presentation currency of the returned amounts. Does not change the input.

headcount.description: Number of people with the SAME salary and settings (whole number 1–100, default 1). Affects only the additive `budget` block; `estimate` always describes one person in January.

tools.name: request_assessment
tools.description: Send a request for a written assessment to Certa Poland (Biuro Rachunkowe Precyzja Sp. z o.o.). A person reads it and replies by email, usually within 1 business day. Before calling, show the user this privacy notice and get their agreement: "We use your details only to reply. If you submit this form, we may also attach information about the source of your visit. Details: Privacy Policy (https://certapoland.com/privacy-policy/)." Set userConfirmedPrivacyNotice to true only after the user agrees. Nothing is booked, signed or paid by this call. This is not legal or tax advice.

employerCountry.description: Region where the employer is registered: EU for EU/EEA/Switzerland, US for the United States, ZZ for any other country

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Ask Certa Poland for a consultation call. Give preferred times with a time zone. A person replies by email with a Google Meet invitation or another proposed time, usually within 1 business day. Nothing is booked automatically. Before calling, show the user this privacy notice and get their agreement: "We use your details only to reply. If you submit this form, we may also attach information about the source of your visit. Details: Privacy Policy (https://certapoland.com/privacy-policy/)." Set userConfirmedPrivacyNotice to true only after the user agrees. This is not legal or tax advice.
